engine: SQLite 3.47.2 and its UTF-8 C API
scope: Retain every byte supplied as a value of SQLite storage class TEXT, including embedded zeros and byte sequences outside UTF-8.
observation: Read sqlite3_column_type before extraction. Read length and bytes from sqlite3_column_text and sqlite3_column_bytes. Emit text with the decoded string when the bytes are valid UTF-8. Emit text-bytes with lowercase hexadecimal when UTF-8 decoding fails. Emit blob for a BLOB value even when its bytes equal those of a TEXT value.
controls: An invalid UTF-8 text value retains all bytes and remains distinct from the identical BLOB bytes.
An embedded zero in valid UTF-8 text remains part of the value.
Replacing storage class or bytes fails the comparison.
trust: Pinned SQLite 3.47.2 C API and the controller ctypes signatures
Lossless UTF-8 classification and hexadecimal transport
